offering_description.value: Develops and implements case management and electronic filing software for courts and other justice agencies. Publishes legal news and court information in print and online for lawyers and other readers, and places statutory notices for law firms, businesses and public agencies.

primary_products.value: Justice case management software; electronic filing software; public court records portals; print and digital legal newspapers

primary_services.value: Software implementation and integration; hosted court software; electronic filing and payment processing; public notice placement

customer_segment.value: B2G: Courts, prosecutors’ offices, public defenders’ offices and other justice agencies; B2B: Law firms, businesses placing legal notices and other advertisers; B2C: Individual legal news subscribers and self-represented court filers

end_markets.value: Court administration; prosecution and public defense; legal services; legal news and public notice advertising

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Court and justice agency software licenses; project or contract: Software implementation, configuration and integration projects; service fees: Ongoing software maintenance and support contracts; transaction or usage fees: Electronic court filing and payment transactions; advertising: Statutory public notices and other newspaper advertisements; subscription: Print and digital legal newspaper access
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; project or contract; service fees; transaction or usage fees; advertising; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Builds case management software around agency workflows and operates filing portals for courts and filers; service provider: Configures software for justice agencies and places notices submitted by law firms, businesses and public agencies; other: Produces legal reporting and publishes court information and public notices for subscribers and other readers

geography_served.value: global: Justice software in the United States, Canada and Australia, with legal publishing concentrated in California and Arizona

specialization.value: related lines: Justice software, legal newspapers and statutory public notice placement

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Court and justice agency procurement, newspaper subscriptions and advertising sales; online: Electronic filing portals and legal news websites; other: Print newspaper delivery to subscribers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Court records and filing systems follow agency security and privacy rules, and public notices follow state publication requirements

notes: The size classification is an estimate based on the company’s presence in justice software and legal publishing.
